description: This file defines a Java interface named DistributedPub for a distributed publishing mechanism using Akka actors. It includes methods for obtaining publisher references, wrapping messages for publication, publishing messages, creating new publisher instances with custom topic extractors, and a static factory method for instantiation.

methods.name: getPublisher
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef representing the publisher actor.

methods.name: wrapForPublication
methods.description: Wraps a message of type T into an envelope suitable for publication.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message to subscribers, sending it via the publisher actor.

methods.name: withTopicExtractor
methods.description: Creates a new DistributedPub instance with a specified topic extractor.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a DistributedPub with given publisher actor and topic extractor.
